patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and LeadIQ share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Amplemarket only if your buying job matches “AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, delivera” rather than LeadIQ's shape. Choose LeadIQ only if your buying job matches “Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 credits; Pr” rather than Amplemarket's shape. Workflow advantage: Amplemarket leans sales-engagement, email-outreach; LeadIQ leans data-enrichment, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and LeadIQ share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Amplemarket is AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, deliverability, and Duo AI assistants.; LeadIQ is Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 credits; Pro from $200/mo..
- Workflow coverage skew: Amplemarket-leaning sales-engagement, email-outreach vs LeadIQ-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management.
- Researched limits: Amplemarket — Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; LeadIQ — Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools.

Limitations — Amplemarket: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Startup already $600/mo annual; Growth/Elite are custom-quoted.; LeadIQ: Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools; Native email sequencing depth is limited versus dedicated engagement platforms.

Poor-fit cases: Amplemarket is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record. · LeadIQ is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools · Avoid Amplemarket if you actually need LeadIQ's motion (Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 c)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
